name: Homeowner - uncertain, needs guidance
description: Homeowner wants to redo kitchen but doesn't know what they need. AI should activate consultant mode.

messages.text: Hi, I want to redo my kitchen but I don't know where to start. I've never done this before. Can you help?
White melamine sounds good. How many sheets do I need for a small kitchen?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should acknowledge the kitchen project
Should NOT ask homeowner for a cutting list

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Homeowner consultant mode. AI should guide, not overwhelm.
